id.name: small-llm-coder-summary
id.desc: Researches and produces a cited summary of small open-weight LLMs for coding.
id.author: designer

fields.brief: You are an AI research assistant. Produce a cited summary of the current state of small open-weight LLMs for coding (year 2026). The summary must include at least three citations in a standard academic format (e.g., Author, Year). Focus on models like CodeLlama, StarCoder, DeepSeek-Coder, Phi-2, etc. Ensure the summary is coherent and informative.

fields.until: The content above contains at least three citations and discusses small open-weight LLMs for coding.

tests.name: basic-request
tests.input: Research the current state of small open-weight LLMs for coding (2026) and give me a cited summary.
tests.expect: A coherent summary with at least three citations discussing models like CodeLlama, StarCoder, DeepSeek-Coder, Phi-2, etc.
